description: Primary keywords: extra group property List mpoint information. By default, the mpoint ID, radius and position are listed. Use the attribute keyword to list all material point attributes that can be listed. Note Use the model precision command to change the precision of listed floating point values.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: List the extra variables at index i.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: List the group names at slot s.

keywords.name: property
keywords.description: List the property values for the property s. If a property string is not given, then all available properties will be listed.
